name: The Mezz teen maker space at OMSI
org: Oregon Museum of Science and Industry (OMSI)
what_you_do: A free maker space for ages 13 to 18. It has music and recording, sewing, digital design, 3D printing, and photo and video. Teens work on their own projects, and staff can help.
who_can_apply: Any teen age 13 to 18. Museum admission is not required to use The Mezz.
pay_detail: Free for teens. Not a job.
duration: Open Tuesday to Sunday, 11 am to 5 pm, Sept 8, 2026 to June 13, 2027
deadline_text: Drop in during open hours. No deadline.
how_to_apply: Just visit during open hours. Teens who want to help run it can apply as Mezz volunteers (see the OMSI teen volunteer card).
notes: The page says some exceptions apply to the listed hours. Ticketed programs are not offered. To visit the rest of the museum you need to pay admission.
